label: Notice supports a meaningful opportunity to participate
explanation: Mullane requires notice reasonably calculated in the circumstances to inform interested parties. Mathews addresses the procedural safeguards appropriate to disability-benefit termination. Read together, the accounts prompt separate questions about whether a person can learn of the proceeding and what opportunity to respond is required. The comparison does not suggest that balancing under Mathews erases Mullane’s notice requirement.
